title: Instructors can preview, select and add single tracks from Music playlists and Songs
acceptance: Playlist detail rows offer preview and select, reusing the builder TrackPreview path, with an "Add selected" or "Start class from selected" action (D21). Music › Songs rows get preview only: RF-151 owns their selection and the Create a class action.
The playlist header shows a track count when the provider reports one, and the 15-song import limit is stated before Start class.
Preview plays only through the official provider SDK or widget; nothing is cached.
Keyboard and screen-reader access match the existing builder preview.
On Music › Songs, preview is a ▶ control on the song artwork (the spot RF-151 reserves); tapping the rest of the row selects it (RF-151) and never starts playback.
nextAction: Owner, 2026-10-31: preview lives on the artwork ▶, never on the row tap (RF-151 owns row selection). Ship after RF-151. Design pass first for playlist detail: what selection adds to (new class or an open class). Files: apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx (Music song rows and playlist dialog), TrackPreview.tsx, PlaylistSongPicker.tsx. Check scripts/owner-gate.mjs for the files the PR actually touches; playback code under apps/web/src/lib/playback/ is gated. Either way the PR needs a real-browser preview check, which CI cannot prove. Surface: web.

evidence.summary: Music song rows and playlist-detail rows render metadata only; the builder lazy-loads TrackPreview. Checked on main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priority 6 and the Music rows on preview, counts and the 15-song cap. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.

Chose option (a) "always in pick mode" ("Let’s try a first") over a Spotify-style Select button, and will smoke test it on Mac and iPhone to judge the feel.
